'''Force barrier''', also known as '''Force (war) shield''', '''Force of Will''', '''Force defense''', or '''Lesser Force Shield''', '''Warding (spell)''', was a primarily defensive [[Force power/Legends|Force power]], exclusive to neither with the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] or [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sides]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], that created a barrier or wall of Force energy around the intended target, be it self, friend, or even foe.

==Description==
[[File:ForceBarrier-ZBSB.png|thumb|left|250px|Yoda, Anakin Skywalker and Aayla Secura protect Chancellor Palpatine and Padmé Amidala from a poison gas cloud]]
Force barrier was a very basic [[Force power/Legends|application]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Depending on the individual, it manifested itself differently, appearing as a shimmering, [[Force Stasis/Legends#Stasis Field|stasis field]] of Force energy,<ref name="Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> or sometimes not "appearing" at all.<ref name="FNU">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising]]''</ref> In combat, these barriers were capable of absorbing a wide variety of physical and energy attacks. Depending on the strength of the individual, the barrier could only withstand a few attacks before collapsing.<ref name="Rule of Two" /> There have been some cases where a barrier has repelled high and low pitched sound. Obi-Wan Kenobi used this technique when a bounty hunter was firing at him with a sonic boom grenade launcher.

==Users==
First practiced by the [[Umbaran Shadow Assassin]]s, the technique was later adopted by both [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Masters would train their pupils to use Force barriers instinctively to the point of becoming a matter of reflex.<ref name="POD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> By at least [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] prepared their students by teaching them to master Force barrier before sending them into battle. One such example was Master [[Arca Jeth]], who, among other things, taught his three apprentices to instinctively create Force shields.<ref name="TOTJA" /> Jedi apprentices on the ancient library [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] also learned Force shielding before going into battle.<ref name="FNU" /> During the [[New Sith Wars]], students of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] learned to implement Force barrier as second nature, practicing it alongside their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] skills in the Academy's dueling ring, lest a Jedi or another Sith simply strike them down with the Force, as they might one without the Force.<ref name="POD" /> In [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[New Jedi Order]], children were taught to protect themselves with shimmering Force barriers when they first began to recognize the power of the Force. At just five years old, Skywalker's twin niece and nephew, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] were proficient in creating Force barriers, having learned directly from their uncle.<ref name="TCS" />

[[File:ThonNomiBattle.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Nomi Sunrider fights with a lightsaber while Master Thon uses Force barrier]]
{{Quote|You want that horny-monster instead? He's throwin' off a force field that'd stop a sandcrawler!|Gudb|<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
While [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] with [[Thon]] on the planet [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], [[Nomi Sunrider]], her daughter [[Vima Sunrider|Vima]], and Thon were [[Skirmish on Ambria|attacked]] by [[Bogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Gangster/Legends|gang]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. When the thugs fired upon Thon and his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]] from their [[Hoversled/Legends|hovercraft]], the Jedi Master was able to use the Force and [[Force deflection/Legends|deflect]] the incoming salvos. Later, when the gang surrounded and seemingly captured the Jedi trio, Thon again used the Force as a golden shield to repel the incoming attacks. The pirate [[Gudb]] described Thon's shield as being strong enough to halt the advance of a [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]].<ref name="TOTJA" />

Emperor [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] of [[Zakuul]] used a minor variation of force shield to defend himself when his own son, [[Arcann]], attacked him. This shield seemed to only surround his hand, but also seemed to protect him from every hit of Arcann's lightsaber.

During the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Dace Diath]], Nomi Sunrider, [[Kith Kark]], and [[Shoaneb Culu]] used the Force collectively to create a defensive war-shield of protection against the attacking [[Naddist]]s. The Force barrier they created was not visible, but it was successful in repelling the onslaught of attacks the Jedi faced as they charged forward.<ref name="FNU" />

During the [[Duel on Tython]], [[Jedi Lord]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] used Force barrier both offensively and defensively against [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. As fellow Jedi Master [[Raskta Lsu]] dueled with Bane, Farfalla shielded Lsu from Bane's [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] onslaught with a Force barrier. When the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] tried to rush [[Worror Dowmat]] (who was providing a source of empowerment to the Jedi through his [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]]), Farfalla again threw up a Force barrier around Bane to halt his attack. Farfalla gathered energy from the light side of the Force, and at the last moment released it in a single concentrated burst of energy, encasing Bane in a [[Force Stasis/Legends|stasis field]] of light side power. This was not enough to subdue a Dark [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] however. The shield exploded into energy fragments as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Bane broke free. At the end of the battle, Dowmat made a blue protection bubble to trap Bane's inferno of Sith lightning, nearly killing the Dark Lord as he died.<ref name="Rule of Two" />

Darth Vader used a semi-visible Force barrier, a [[Protection bubble]] around himself, while fighting Rebel terrorists, after their bombing of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 1">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 1|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 1]]</ref>

After being kidnapped by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Hethrir]], then-five-years-old Jacen and Jaina Solo attempted to shield themselves and their brother [[Anakin Solo|Anakin]] with a shimmering Force barrier. Hethrir's command of the Force was superior to theirs, however. He [[Force suppression|simply caused the twins' barrier to collapse as though it were made of sand]].<ref name="TCS" /> Jaina also would go on to destroy a [[Tsik Seru]] with this power, making the Yuuzhan Vong ship blow itself up when it took a shot that slammed into the wall of will she conjured, making its own magma blast explode and rend it apart.<ref>''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion]]''</ref>

Jacen Solo once protected both himself and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]] from an explosion in the hotel district south of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], by wrapping their taxicab in a Force shield which absorbed the full brunt of the blast.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

==Behind the scenes==
On the PS3 and Xbox 360 versions of [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]] both Jedi and Sith that [[Galen Marek]] fights utilize this technique. [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], and even [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] uses it, even using it to block off Galen's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and his [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. The [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] used a lightning variant of this power that also harmed the approaching opponent, aside from shielding the Dark Lord. It was often used by them when these masters were preparing for a powerful force attack; namely when Kota flings his 'saber in the air to initiate a ground slam; Shaak Ti, whenever she is preparing to launch a force sphere; Darth Vader, whenever he is about to unleash a blast of the Force, and the Emperor, whenever he is about to use [[Force lightning/Legends#Variants of Force lightning|Lightning grenade]].
